title: Arquivo Vivo — Entry Schema
description: Schema for entries in the Arquivo Vivo da Sabedoria Prática catalog. Part of Eixo SELVA.

id.description: Sequential ID, never reused, format AV-NNNN

resumo.description: Factual summary, kept separate from any interpretive analysis

analise.description: Optional interpretive layer. MUST be ev-inference and MUST NOT be mixed into resumo.

evidencia.description: ev-confirmed requires 2+ independent sources. Single-source items are ev-alleged, never promoted without corroboration.

tipo.description: e.g. reportagem, registro público, testemunho, documento oficial

fontes.description: R1 rule (borrowed from JusMonitor governance): no ev-confirmed entry may ship with an empty fontes[].

lacuna_investigativa.description: Precisely named unknown, if any — never implies suspicion, only states what remains unverified

genericizacao_check.description: True only if the entry passed the specificity test: has verifiable source, is not generic motivational content, and would plausibly still matter in 20 years

imagem.description: Path to the case visual used in catalog card and detail reading

secoes.description: Structured detalhamento for the reading view. Factual only; interpretive notes stay in analise.
